title: Kiti ya Bokonzi ya Solo
intro: Mokonzi moko ya nguya, oyo ayebani mpo na bwanya na bango monene mpe kiti na bango ya bokonzi ya nkembo, azwi nsango moko ya kobombama oyo euti na esika oyo eyebani te. Kosolola oyo ekanisamaki te ezali kotya ntembe na bindimeli mpe bokonzi na bango, kotiaka bango na mobembo ya diplomasi oyo ekomeka mayele na bango mpe na nsuka ekokamba na kolamuka ya mozindo ya molimo. Okoki kobimisa bomoto ya mokonzi yango mpe makambo oyo ebongolaki bokonzi na bango mobimba?
clues: Ngai na bato na ngai tosambelaki moi, kolanda banzela ya bankoko na biso.
Ndɛkɛ, hoopoe, ezalaki momemi-nsango oyo ekoki kosalema te oyo amemelaki ngai mokanda oyo eutaki epai ya mokambi moko ya nguya.
Mpo na komeka mayele ya motindi, natindaki makabo ya motuya, kasi bazongisaki yango, lokola motindi azalaki na bozwi mingi koleka uta na Allah.
Liboso kutu nakóma na ndako ya motindi, kiti na ngai ya bokonzi ya kokamwa ememamaki kuna na ndenge ya likamwisi na mbala moko.
Ntango nakómaki kuna, batunaki ngai soki kiti ya bokonzi oyo bamemaki ezali ya ngai, mpe nayanolaki ete, ‘Ezali lokola nde ezali yango mpenza.’
Nakotaki na ndako monene na etaze oyo nakanisaki ete ezali pisini ya mai, mpe na ngonga wana ya bobangi, namikitisaki pembeni ya Ntoma Sulaiman epai ya Allah, Nkolo ya mokili.

arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدْخُلِى ٱلصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةًۭ وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرْحٌۭ مُّمَرَّدٌۭ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verse: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allāh, Lord of the worlds." (27:44)
